description: Restyle Leave and Attendance pages (LeaveDashboard, AttendanceDashboard, AttendanceUpload, plus any old-style leftovers in leaves/, attendance/, payroll/, dashboard/) with shared components; keep all logic and no_overtime_clock.png. Depends on FEAT-001; independent of FEAT-003/004.
steps: Rebuild LeaveDashboard.tsx with PageContainer/PageHeader, Card, StatCard, ChartCard/DonutChart, Tabs, Button/ButtonLink/IconButton, Select/Input/Checkbox, Modal, StateView, Iconify; keep every hook/query/handler/derived value
Add any missing Solar icons to src/components/Iconify
Run grep gate (plan.md item 6) on leaves/, attendance/, payroll/, dashboard/ and fix hits

All Koushik functionality (tabs, filters, charts, upload flow, handlers, API calls) still present
Pages render in the existing smoke routes
verification: cd worktree: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS' is <= 119
npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -c ': warning' is <= 226

All hooks/queries/derived values kept. no_overtime_clock.png kept. No new icons needed. payroll/ and dashboard/ had no gate hits. Gates: tsc 116 (<=119), vitest 19 pass, vite build ok, playwright leaves|attendance 9 pass. Leave tab has pre-existing TS error at LeaveDashboard ~334 (his code). Remaining grep hits in leaves/, attendance/: none (arrow chars only in CheckInButton comments).
